selection.criteria: One acquisition per visit; every link explicitly clear; 4-15 present labels per visit; persistence plus newly appearing; no merging; >=3 lung/liver rows. Rank larger minimum lesion volume then larger new lesion, then patient ID. Purposive contrast to first nodal-merger case, not prevalence sampling.
selection.selection_timing: After descriptive metadata exploration, before new CT download and any new model output.
selection.limitations: Present counts derive from topology and deduplicated destination IDs, not whole-mask validation. Row anatomy counts are longitudinal rows, not baseline prevalence. No tiny lesions will be removed from the selected reference. Selection awaits native-image/GT sanity review.

acquisition.checks: Exact HTTP 206 range, decompressed size, per-member ZIP CRC32, SHA256 receipt

geometry.limits: Geometry/label checks and author visual review do not constitute expert malignancy adjudication. GT-selected slices/crops are author-only; no solver hints.

author_review.assessment: Native CT/GT geometry, source label inventory, CSV volumes and all-22 max-area slice/crop sheets inspected. No inter-label 6-connected contact, no label at volume boundary, no obvious defacing overlap in displayed targets. Many liver targets are subtle; reference appearance is not clinically adjudicated.
limits: No clinical-report context is provided to the solver although source annotators used reports.
One large liver label will dominate foreground Dice; retain equal-lesion metrics and size strata.
Newness remains source-reference correspondence, not independent clinical adjudication.
Whole-volume native images are 615/743 slices, 2.0/2.5 mm spacing; do not assume the paper typical 3 mm setting.
